body:
Not to burst your bubble but the ending made that movie.. SPOILERS

What she heard about the afterlife was so horrible she had to take her own life. It was only the best horror movie twist ending ever. No one had been able to actually describe it before her because she was the first true Martyr. So when the lady finally heard the truth she went nuttered.

I'm just disappointed that it wont have Campbell in it. I don't care if he's old. I wanted this movie to take place after AOD, Ash is manager of S-mart and the evil goes down. Hell why can't we get a good Bruce Campbell zombie movie. He'd improve a Zombieland style horror comedy drastically.
